tools.name: search_contacts
tools.title: Search contacts
tools.description: Search the dialer's contacts by business name, contact person or phone number. Returns matching contact records with their IDs.

query.description: Business name, person name or phone number fragment.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.title: Get contact detail
tools.description: Fetch one contact's full record plus its most recent call logs and notes. Use search_contacts first to find the contact ID.

tools.name: my_call_activity
tools.title: My call activity
tools.description: Summarise the signed-in rep's own call activity over the last N days: total dials, a breakdown by outcome, and total talk time.

tools.name: list_follow_ups
tools.title: List my follow-ups and bookings
tools.description: List the signed-in rep's scheduled pipeline items (follow-ups and booked appointments) within a date window.

days_ahead.description: How far forward to look, in days (default 7).

days_back.description: How far back to include overdue items (default 7).

pipeline_type.description: Restrict to one pipeline type. Omit for both.

tools.name: add_contact_note
tools.title: Add a contact note
tools.description: Add a note to a contact's timeline in the dialer, authored by the signed-in user.

tools.name: tonights_email_round
tools.title: Tonight's email round
tools.description: List the leads the signed-in rep flagged in the dialer as 'Worth an email tonight' that are still unsent. Returns each lead's name, business, recipient email, phone, when it was flagged and the latest call notes. Unsent flags carry over from previous days, so this is the full outstanding email round.

include_sent_today.description: Also include leads already marked sent today (default false).

tools.name: describe_data
tools.title: Describe the data
tools.description: Data dictionary for Speedy Dialer: what each table and column means, the call outcome vocabulary, exact KPI formulas (connect rate, booking rate, funnel stages), the Melbourne-timezone rule for daily metrics, and common traps. Call this BEFORE writing a report from other tools' output so numbers are interpreted correctly.

topic.description: Narrow the dictionary to one area (default 'all').

tools.name: report_snapshot
tools.title: Report snapshot
tools.description: Pre-aggregated dialling metrics for a report: dials, conversations, connect rate, bookings, booking rate, talk minutes, funnel-stage counts and outcome breakdown. All day boundaries are Australia/Melbourne local time. Defaults to the signed-in rep ('me'); admins and coaches can pass scope 'team' for a per-rep breakdown. Pair with describe_data for formula definitions.

days.description: Number of consecutive Melbourne days ending on `date` (default 1).
